apiPlan.receipt: native return/error + owner M birth + opaque handle; returned ALL_ACCESS is not justification to distribute it
KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE and no breakaway; success return+error, actual hierarchy and ACL; none substitutes for membership
expected sizing call may report required buffer; validate documented buffer protocol, dwFlags0, JOB_LIST ordered; HANDLE_LIST IPC-only inheritable list and bInheritHandlesTRUE
API BOOL/error; actual process/thread handles and creation identity; no Assign fallback, success alone not creator-loss proof
retained handle/native creation identity/Job/VM generation/owner match; evidence before resume
separate return value incl failure DWORD(-1); do not infer process completed or fully resumed from arbitrary nonfailure suspend count

rights.job: SET_ATTRIBUTES for limits, QUERY for query/membership, TERMINATE for stop, ASSIGN_PROCESS for Assign API reference only; exact JOB_LIST-specific access prerequisites still require implementation/VM review
rights.process: QUERY_INFORMATION or QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION for GetProcessTimes; SYNCHRONIZE for wait; TERMINATE only owned target; SET_QUOTA+TERMINATE applies to Assign reference, not silently adopted fallback
rights.thread: SUSPEND_RESUME for ResumeThread; query rights for optional GetThreadTimes
rights.inheritance: Job handle non-inherited, IPC allowlist explicit; no pseudo handles; every duplicate/leak audited

creatorLoss: at every stage -> UNKNOWN/NOT_OBTAINED, remaining BLOCKED; independent R target recovery needed; no universal kernel rollback claim
stopExitRelease: separate request/API result/handle wait+exit/resource close facts; last-close unknown not successful termination
